# DB-backed .github/agentic-hardware-blueprint.md

> 本文件是兼容 shim：完整原文已提升到 `.github/cache/github-index.sqlite` 的 stored document。
> 原文件备份位于 `.github/db-backup/2026-06-11-agent-env-db-first/files/.github/agentic-hardware-blueprint.md`。

- 按需加载：`python3 scripts/github_index_db.py load --source stored --path .github/agentic-hardware-blueprint.md`
- 从备份恢复：`python3 scripts/github_index_db.py restore --backup-dir .github/db-backup/2026-06-11-agent-env-db-first --path .github/agentic-hardware-blueprint.md --yes`
- 重新物化：`python3 scripts/github_index_db.py materialize --path .github/agentic-hardware-blueprint.md`
